scope: Competition EEG summary regression only. Separate from the deferred behavioral protocol.
prior_access: Progress and sensory engineering baselines already evaluated; no hyperparameters selected from those scores.
targets: Eight recorded-voltage summary features, not attention or learning
shared_support: Identical rows with every required block and target available; exclusions reported per viewing
dimension_match: Concatenate native text/audio/video features before one training-only PCA capped at 16; TRIBE receives one PCA capped at 16. Report achieved ranks in every fold; no dimension-match claim for unequal ranks.
scaling_and_pca: Training-only; distinct training content windows for feature transforms, no held-out EEG or content
folds: 8 crossed topic-family by participant-group cells, unchanged
uncertainty: Paired held-out absolute-error differences, crossed participant and lecture resampling; descriptive intervals only with four lectures and two topic families
deployment: A separately labelled exploratory full-data fit only after all prescribed evaluation arms finish; never score deployment training rows as validation
scientific_limits: no attention or retention labels in this stage
